ca_lake_ramona.name: Lake Ramona
ca_lake_ramona.note: No Lake Ramona-specific month source; only San Diego/Mt Woodson season words (spring/fall best, summer hot).

ok_mount_scott.name: Mount Scott
ok_mount_scott.note: Spring and fall named as best, summer hot, winter windy; no source names months.

or_southwest_oregon.name: Southwest Oregon
or_southwest_oregon.note: Late spring-early fall / spring and fall in words only; no months named, region-wide.

ut_left_fork_2.name: Left Fork
ut_left_fork_2.note: KAYA: fall Sep-Nov prime, spring Mar-May; ClimbingAway lists Jan-Jun for Left Fork (spring part agrees); summer too hot.

az_3_windy_point_east.name: Windy Point East
az_3_windy_point_east.note: A guide names Feb, Apr, May, Sep, Oct, Nov for Mt Lemmon; SummitPost and Tucson press say spring and fall (Mar filled in); summer cooler but stormy.

ca_bishop_peak.name: Bishop Peak
ca_bishop_peak.note: South-facing, spring/fall comfortable in words only; no months named.

me_camden_hills.name: Camden Hills
me_camden_hills.note: Late spring to early fall, fall best, in words (May festival opens season); no month list.

va_dc_northern_va_region.name: DC & Northern VA Region
va_dc_northern_va_region.note: Spring and fall in words; no months named.

co_clear_creek_canyon_bouldering.name: Clear Creek Canyon Bouldering
co_clear_creek_canyon_bouldering.note: Madboulder: fall through spring (summer heat); Golden guide names Apr, May, Sep, Oct best; winter dry days possible on sunny walls.

wa_mclellan_rocks.name: McLellan Rocks
wa_mclellan_rocks.note: MP: April through October; Sendage: long season, hot July-August.

ca_castle_rock_area.name: Castle Rock Area
ca_castle_rock_area.note: Fall through spring in words, year-round possible; no months named.

co_uncompahgre_gorge_aka_ouray_ice_park.name: Uncompahgre Gorge aka Ouray Ice Park
co_uncompahgre_gorge_aka_ouray_ice_park.note: Ice-only venue: park says mid-December to late March; SummitPost mid-Dec to ~Apr 1; opening varies by year (2026 opened Jan 21). Ice season, not rock.

ny_crane_mountain.name: Crane Mountain
ny_crane_mountain.note: Fall best by general advice, bugs bad May-June; no month-naming climbing source.

ca_pine_creek_canyon.name: Pine Creek Canyon
ca_pine_creek_canyon.note: Late spring to late fall / spring and fall in words only; no months named.

ca_roadside_rocks_4.name: Roadside Rocks
ca_roadside_rocks_4.note: Joshua Tree: mid-October to early May, fall and spring prime, winter viable, summer too hot.

co_eagle_vail_minturn_red_cliff.name: Eagle/Vail/Minturn/Red Cliff
co_eagle_vail_minturn_red_cliff.note: Discover Vail: June through September, late spring to early fall; ice Dec-Mar not counted; one guide service says rock year-round.

qc_chez_roger.name: Chez Roger
qc_chez_roger.note: No season or months found for the park's climbing.

ab_kananaskis.name: Kananaskis
ab_kananaskis.note: One guide: June to late fall; another: mid-spring to mid-October; shared window Jun-Oct. Ice not counted.

bc_vancouver.name: Vancouver
bc_vancouver.note: HELD by reviewer: Squamish sources applied to Vancouver crags; no Vancouver source. Squamish-area sources: driest June-Sept (Jun-Aug best); season early spring to late fall; wet Nov-Mar. Region-wide, shoulder months excluded.

nv_sandstone_quarry.name: Sandstone Quarry
nv_sandstone_quarry.note: Red Rocks: October to early April, Nov-Mar prime; others cite Mar-May and Sep-Nov; summer too hot. Area-specific source not found.
